cohort: 72 patients with postpartum haemorrhage at a tertiary care center in [unspecified country]
finding: The prevalence of B-Lynch suture use for atonic postpartum hemorrhage was 26.39% (90% CI 17.85-34.93), with a 94.74% uterus salvage rate.
mod_finding: Cesarean hysterectomy was performed in a small percentage of patients who underwent B-Lynch suture management for atonic postpartum hemorrhage.
